# ML-DSA-87 independent known-answer vectors

Selected directly from the NIST ACVP server fixtures at revision
`975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d`:
https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server/tree/975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d/gen-val/json-files

For each `ML-DSA-{keyGen,sigGen,sigVer}-FIPS204` directory, merge `prompt.json`
and `expectedResults.json` by `tcId`. Select ML-DSA-87, and for signatures only
`signatureInterface=external`, `preHash=pure`. Keep the first three cases per
key-generation/signature-generation group and all signature-verification cases.
No values are regenerated by the implementation under test. These are public test
secrets, never operational keys. Tests exercise the dependency's public FIPS interface;
separate wrapper tests enforce the application's fixed contexts and key roles.
This is interoperability evidence, not NIST certification.

Upstream US government data disclaimer/license:
https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server/blob/975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d/README.md
